sources.title: Splitter AI — Isolate instruments from a song
sources.snippet: AI-Powered Music Separator This app allows to separate music into an individual streams such as vocal, bass, percussion, and lets you rebalance their individual volumes. This is the simplest way to get multitracks from any song. Once you choose a song, artificial intelligence will separate music into stems: vocals, bass, drums, others. Processing usually takes about 1 minute.
